build.linker: Modwerk engine linkMods (scripts/link-image.mjs), no other mods

checks.name: machine list
checks.detail: LOOP&FADE appears after SLICE in FUNC + SRC; YES twice puts machine 122 on track 2 (core_track_machine reads 0x7a).

checks.name: page 2
checks.detail: SRC on the looper's SRC page opens page 2 (MODE, MAX, SRCE, RLEV, BTN, GLOB, PLAY, LOOP); its knobs turn through the stock knob routines (MODE to CAPT, MAX to 16, PLAY to PICK).

checks.name: ONCE capture
checks.detail: Audio on, demo pattern playing: UP on the SRC page arms (stage 1), the next loop records (stage 2) and is handed over and locked after 64 steps (ram_locked 1, 470,144 samples).

checks.name: crossfader settings
checks.detail: SETTINGS > CROSSFADER is the last row; LEFT/RIGHT set groups; trig key 2 on FADER ON ticks track 2.

checks.name: fader on pages
checks.detail: LEVEL on the Internal Mixer (2/3) moves the fader shown at the lower left; on track 2's AMP page (FADER ON) the fader box replaces the level bar.

checks.name: audio-block load
checks.detail: 3,000 blocks, instruction-timing model at 250 MHz: core and Machine Pages alone 60.3% mean / 62.0% worst; with Loop & Fade idle 61.8% / 63.5%; CAPT + WARP loop, GLOB ALL, ten channels on the crossfader 66.0% / 67.7%; CAPT + PICK 64.5% / 66.2%.

checks.name: shared memory
checks.detail: 19,492 bytes of the 128 KiB shared mod area (ramSpare 125,076 without the module, 105,584 with it).

notTested: Hardware: the full run of this build is still to do; on draadpiraat's unit it slows down while an Overbridge instance is open (stock not yet compared).
Audio content: the emulator's recording path is not checked for level, clicks or noise.
PTCH and WARP tempo following, the trim editor, GLOB across pattern changes, the fader CC, settings persistence across a power cycle.
